book.title: Homeland (Forgotten Realms: The Dark Elf Trilogy, #1; Legend of Drizzt, #1)
book.description: In exotic Menzoberranzan, the vast city of the drow is home to Icewind Dale prince Drizzt Do'Urden, who grows to maturity in the vile world of his dark elf kin. Possessing honor beyond the scope of his unprincipled society, can he live in world that rejects integrity?
